verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible left-to-right order (presenter, headline, date, can, CTA), but it is badly fragmented. The tagline is squeezed into a 6-line sliver column, the RSVP pill is the same size as the info pills so the CTA gets lost, the can is a tiny afterthought and the legal block is nearly as prominent as the details. B has the stronger one-line headline, but 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' sits under the title, which inverts the reading order. B's tagline and the 'Reserve a spot' line are jammed against the top edge, 'Saturday 21 June' breaks awkwardly beside a cramped 3-line detail block, the pills form a ragged 2x2 with uneven gaps and the logo wordmark looks clipped. Overall B is more cramped and disordered than A.
